name: Nguom Ngao Cave
summary: Walk the lit passage at Nguom Ngao on the same day as Ban Gioc. The cave is about 4 km from the falls, in Ban Gun. Vietnam Tourism says about an hour or more for the open kilometre. Skip the rough Ban Thuon branch unless you have asked whether that longer visit is the one on offer.
timeNeeded: About an hour or more for the lit walk
getThere: About 4 km from Ban Gioc, on the same Dam Thuy day.
heroCaption: A lit chamber in Nguom Ngao, with stalactite columns

notice.title: The long branch is not the lit walk
notice.body: Vietnam Tourism gives about an hour or more for the open kilometre. The Ban Thuon branch is nearly 3 km, with climbing and wading. Do not budget them as the same hour.

body: The ordinary visit is an electrically lit passage. Guides name shapes in the chambers, including a golden falls, an upside-down lotus, and terraces. The Tay name is tiger cave. The floor is wet. Wear shoes you can soak.

Lengths do not collapse into one figure. Vietnam Tourism says the system is 2,144 m, with 948 m open to ordinary visitors. The geopark says more than 2,000 m and three mouths: Nguom Ngao, Nguom Lom, and Ban Thuon. From 2021 a Ban Thuon branch of nearly 3 km was opened for a rougher visit. Ask which mouth you are buying before you pay.
Do this with the falls, in the morning or early afternoon, not as a separate journey from Hanoi. The fee is check on arrival. No tariff page was reloaded for this cave.

figures.caption: The lit walkway inside Nguom Ngao
figures.alt: A path through a yellow-lit chamber of Nguom Ngao cave, with stalactites overhead

gettingThere: Nguom Ngao is at Ban Gun, in Dam Thuy, about 4 km from Ban Gioc on the 2025 eastern-route article. A 2023 geopark article still says Trung Khanh. Go with the falls day. Minutes from the city are the same unsourced drive as the falls, more than 80 km, plus the short hop in the valley.

legs.heading: From Ban Gioc
legs.body: About 4 km, on the cave road through the valley. The exact minutes are check on arrival. Khuoi Ky, the stone stilt-house village, sits on this road. It has no licensed photograph here, so it is not a separate stop on this page.

legs.heading: From Cao Bang city
legs.body: The eastern road, more than 80 km to the valley, then the short hop to the cave. Drive minutes are check on arrival. No local-bus time was published.

closed: No weekly closing day was on the pages read. Check the board on arrival.
admissionNote: Check on arrival. This pass did not reload a tariff. The lit walk and the Ban Thuon branch are different visits. Ask which one the ticket is for.
